name: 白眼潛鴨
illustrationTaxon: Aythya nyroca adult male breeding plumage

similarSpecies.distinction: 繁殖羽雄鳥暗綠光頭、淡眼、栗胸及栗白脅部；沒有鳳頭潛鴨的長冠羽和黑胸。
繁殖羽雄鳥橙褐頭、紅眼，暗喙具寬灰帶，灰脅配黑胸；並非全栗褐體。

featureNotes: 繁殖羽雄鳥白色虹膜；雌鳥眼暗
背及翼較胸脅暗，無鳳頭
多數個體白色尾下覆羽顯眼

rangeMap.note: World-view partial native country overview; combined breeding/winter countries, not complete species range, seasonal polygons or whole-country occupancy. 38–42cm. Steep forehead crown peak intermediate between tufted/common pochard; breeding male dark chestnut, paler flanks darker mantle/back WHITE iris, conspicuous white undertail. Female dull brown dark eye. White flight wingbar not illustrated in folded-wing portraits. Breeds E Europe to western/central Kazakhstan/western Mongolia, disjunct south/N China; China N Xinjiang/N China breeding, Yunnan/Yangtze/Taiwan winter. NT decreasing.

Comparison source read: 41–47cm. Breeding male pale white/yellow iris, dark green gloss head/neck, deep orangebrown breast, chestnut and WHITE flanks, white undertail; female dark eye darkbrown head chestnut lores. Native range substantially contracted; originally NE China adjacent Russia and winter S China/N Indochina/NE Indian subcontinent. Current China breeds NE south to Yangtze floodplain and winters scattered south Yellow River; few now outside China. CR. Historic 150–700 mature figure NOT presented as current count.

Comparison source read: 42–49cm. Domed crown smooth head-bill junction; male reddish eyes orangebrown head, broad pale greyish band on dark bill, black breast/stern, pale grey vermiculated upperparts/flanks. Breeds E Europe/S Scandinavia to Russia/Kazakhstan/Mongolia/NE China, winters western Europe/N and E Africa/N Indian subcontinent/N Indochina/S China/E Asia/N Philippines. VU rapidly decreasing.
